Before Vitest 5, browser mode had three providers: **Playwright** (`@vitest/browser-playwright`), **WebdriverIO** (`@vitest/browser-webdriverio`) and **preview** (`@vitest/browser-preview`). Preview opens your real browser but can't run headless or in CI.

**Vitest 5.0.0 removed the WebdriverIO package**, which is listed as a breaking change (#10675) in the release notes. That leaves Playwright as the main provider; the release only mentions it in bug fixes. The notes don't mention the preview provider, so I'm assuming it's unchanged rather than confirmed. If you're on Vitest 5 and use WebdriverIO, you'll need to move to Playwright.

Sources:
- [Vitest v5.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/releases/tag/v5.0.0)
